scripts.format:check: corepack pnpm -r format:check && uv run --project services/api --extra dev ruff format services/api --check
scripts.lint: node --check scripts/dev.mjs && corepack pnpm -r lint && uv run --project services/api --extra dev ruff check services/api
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r typecheck && uv run --project services/api --extra dev mypy --config-file services/api/pyproject.toml services/api/src
scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r test && uv run --project services/api --extra dev pytest services/api/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp .vikram/pytest
